# Alpha Diversity

```{r}
ps <- readRDS(
    glue("{palm_interim}/",
        "phyloseq_count_matrix_BWA-dlist-GRCh38-dna-rna",
        "_decontaminated-outlier-removed-&_cleanread-normed_2024-11-04.rds"
    )
)

# Alpha diversity Analysis
total_observed <- microbiome::alpha(ps)
alpha_stats_df <- total_observed %>%
    rownames_to_column(var = "sample_id") %>%
    left_join(meta(ps), by = "sample_id") %>%
    glimpse()

alpha_stats_df %>% glimpse


p_alpha_obs <- alpha_stats_df %>%
    filter(case_control_other_latest != "Other") %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = case_control_other_latest, y = observed)) +
    geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.2), alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0, alpha = 0.2) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Unique vOTUs") +
    theme_light()

p_alpha_shan <- alpha_stats_df %>%
    filter(case_control_other_latest != "Other") %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = case_control_other_latest, y = diversity_shannon)) +
    geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.2), alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0, alpha = 0.2) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Shannon's Diversity") +
    # scale_y_log10() +
    theme_light()

p_alpha_plots <- p_alpha_obs + p_alpha_shan

ggsave(
    glue("{wkdir}/figures/Viral/",
        "alpha-diversity-metrics_{Sys.Date()}.png"
    ),
    p_alpha_plots,
    width = 5, height = 5
)


mds_tests <- alpha_stats_df %>%
    dplyr::select(matches("mds_updrs.*_summary_score")) %>%
    colnames()

mds_plots <- list()
for (test in mds_tests){
    # Get data for current test
    plot_data <- alpha_stats_df %>%
        filter(case_control_other_latest == "Case")
    
    # Calculate y range to position labels
    y_range <- range(plot_data$observed)
    y_span <- diff(y_range)
    label_y_cor <- y_range[2] - 0.05 * y_span
    label_y_eq <- y_range[2] - 0.10 * y_span
    
    # Calculate x range to position labels
    x_range <- range(plot_data[[test]], na.rm = TRUE)
    x_span <- diff(x_range) 
    label_x <- x_range[1] + 0.05 * x_span
    
    mds_plots[[test]] <- plot_data %>%
        ggplot(aes(x = !!sym(test), y = observed)) +
        geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "blue", alpha = 0.2) +
        geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.2), alpha = 0.6) +
        stat_cor(method = "pearson", 
                 label.x = label_x,
                 label.y = label_y_cor) +
        stat_regline_equation(label.x = label_x,
                            label.y = label_y_eq) +
        theme_light()
    print(mds_plots[[test]])
}

# Combine plots into 2x2 grid using patchwork
mds_plots_combined <- wrap_plots(mds_plots, ncol = 2, nrow = 2)
mds_plots_combined

ggsave(
    glue("{wkdir}/figures/Viral/",
        "alpha-diversity-metrics-vs-MDS-scores_{Sys.Date()}.png"
    ),
    mds_plots_combined,
    width = 9, height = 9
)

```

# Beta Diversity

```{r}

ps_clr <- ps %>% microbiome::transform("clr")

# Calculate Euclidean distances between samples using CLR-transformed abundances
euc_dist <- phyloseq::distance(ps_clr, method = "euclidean")

# Perform ordination using phyloseq
ord <- phyloseq::ordinate(ps_clr, method = "PCoA", distance = euc_dist)

# ord %>% glimpse
# Create base ordination plots using phyloseq's plot_ordination
p1 <- phyloseq::plot_ordination(ps_clr, ord, color = "case_control_other_latest") +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1) +
    scale_color_d3() +
    stat_ellipse(aes(color = case_control_other_latest), type = "norm", linetype = 2) +
    labs(title = "Colored by Case/Control Status") +
    theme_bw() +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme(
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "right",
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 11)
    )

p2 <- phyloseq::plot_ordination(ps_clr, ord, color = "study") +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1) +
    scale_color_d3() +
    stat_ellipse(aes(color = study), type = "norm", linetype = 2) +
    labs(title = "Colored by Study") +
    theme_bw() +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme(
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "right",
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 11)
    )

p3 <- phyloseq::plot_ordination(ps_clr, ord, justDF = TRUE) %>%
    left_join(alpha_stats_df, by = "sample_id") %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = Axis.1, y = Axis.2, color = observed)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1) +
    scale_color_viridis_c() +
    labs(title = "Colored by Observed Virus Counts",
         color = "Virus Count") +
    theme_bw() +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme(
        legend.position = "right",
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 11)
    )

p4 <- phyloseq::plot_ordination(ps_clr, ord, 
color = "mds_updrs_part_iii_summary_score") +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1) +
    scale_color_viridis_c() +
    labs(title = "Colored by UPDRS III Score",
         color = "UPDRS III") +
    theme_bw() +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme(
        legend.position = "right",
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 11)
    )

# Combine plots using patchwork
p_combined <- (p1 + p2) / (p3 + p4) +
    plot_annotation(
        title = "PCoA of CLR-transformed Viral Abundances",
        caption = paste0("PC1 (", round(ord$values$Relative_eig[1]*100, 1), "%) vs ",
                        "PC2 (", round(ord$values$Relative_eig[2]*100, 1), "%)\n",
                        "Using Euclidean distances. Dashed lines show 95% confidence ellipses"),
        theme = theme(
            plot.title = element_text(size = 14),
            plot.caption = element_text(size = 10)
        )
    )

ggsave(
    glue("{wkdir}/figures/Viral/",
        "pcoa_clr-transformed_viral_abundances_multipanel_{Sys.Date()}.png"
    ),
    p_combined,
    width = 12, height = 12
)



```


Visualizing sample distances between participants and groups

```{r}
# Convert distance matrix to data.table format
dist_dt <- as.data.table(as.matrix(euc_dist), keep.rownames = "sample1")
dist_dt <- melt(dist_dt, 
                id.vars = "sample1",
                variable.name = "sample2",
                value.name = "distance")
# Get sample metadata as data.table
sample_meta_dt <- meta(ps_clr) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_id, participant_id, case_control_other_latest, visit_month)

# Join metadata for both samples using dplyr syntax
dist_dt_annotated <- dist_dt %>%
  # Join first sample metadata
  left_join(
    sample_meta_dt %>%
      rename(
        sample1 = sample_id,
        participant_id1 = participant_id,
        case_control1 = case_control_other_latest,
        visit_month1 = visit_month
      ),
    by = "sample1"
  ) %>%
  # Join second sample metadata  
  left_join(
    sample_meta_dt %>%
      rename(
        sample2 = sample_id,
        participant_id2 = participant_id,
        case_control2 = case_control_other_latest,
        visit_month2 = visit_month
      ),
    by = "sample2"
  ) %>%
  # Select final columns
  select(
    sample1, sample2, distance,
    participant_id1, participant_id2,
    case_control1, case_control2,
    visit_month1, visit_month2
  ) %>% 
  filter(case_control1 != "Other" | case_control2 != "Other") %>% 
  glimpse()

dist_dt_annotated %>% glimpse


dist_dt_annotated <- dist_dt_annotated %>% 
    mutate(
        participant_comparison = ifelse(participant_id1 == participant_id2, 
                                "Within participant", 
                                "Between participants"),
    ,
    comparison_type = case_when(
        case_control1 == "Case" & case_control2 == "Case" ~ "Within Case",
        case_control1 == "Control" & case_control2 == "Control" ~ "Within Control",
        case_control1 == "Case" & case_control2 == "Control" ~ "Between Groups (Case to Control)",
        case_control1 == "Control" & case_control2 == "Case" ~ "Between Groups (Control to Case)",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
) %>% 
glimpse()

dist_dt_annotated %>% glimpse
dist_dt_annotated$comparison_type %>% table()
dist_dt_annotated$participant_comparison %>% table()


p_dist_comparison_type <- dist_dt_annotated %>% 
    filter(sample1 != sample2) %>%
    filter(comparison_type != "Other") %>%
    group_by(comparison_type) %>%
    sample_n(20000) %>%
    ggplot(aes(y = distance, x = comparison_type)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.3, 
               position = position_jitter(width = 0.2), 
               size = 0.5) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0, alpha = 0.2) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(y = "Aitchison Distance", x = NULL) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

ggsave(
    glue("{wkdir}/figures/Viral/",
        "distance-between-samples-by-comparison-type_{Sys.Date()}.png"
    ),
    p_dist_comparison_type,
    width = 7, height = 8
)

#
p_dist_participant_comparison <- dist_dt_annotated %>% 
    filter(sample1 != sample2) %>%
    group_by(participant_comparison) %>%
    sample_n(1490) %>%
    ggplot(aes(y = distance, x = participant_comparison)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.3, 
               position = position_jitter(width = 0.2), 
               size = 0.5) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0, alpha = 0.2) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(y = "Aitchison Distance", x = NULL) +

ggsave(
```
